We use the triangle law of addition to add the vectors $a$ and $b.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14251309/assets/a493346a118732d2b435e1757bcbabe756c5d0482aec0688c095b7151352d4c7.png)

Notice that we obtain a right triangle. So, we can use the Pythagorean theorem as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{|a+b|}^{2} & ={|a|}^{2}+{|b|}^{2} \\  & ={15}^{2}+{9}^{2} \\  & =306\end{aligned}
$$

Hence, $|a+b|=\sqrt{306}=3\sqrt{34}.$
